overrides.replacement_claim: Aggregate performance projections omit durable lifecycle and cancellation state because they bypass durable-run enrichment.
overrides.reason: Both theories describe one projection defect. Executable evidence confirms that direct status contains running and cancellation-requested state while aggregate API and HTML surfaces return defaults.

overrides.replacement_claim: The performance evidence endpoint can return an unversioned artifact payload instead of the versioned PerformanceEvidenceResult DTO.
overrides.reason: Executable evidence reaches the fallback branch and observes a successful payload without schema_version or records, while the control returns the versioned DTO.

overrides.replacement_claim: Runtime validation rejects documented performance maxima above built-in defaults.
overrides.reason: Executable evidence confirms that the documented commands maximum of 256 is rejected while the default and lower values load.

overrides.replacement_claim: PerformanceResult returns an unclassified raw error when no terminal result exists, bypassing performance-specific transport mapping.
overrides.reason: The unavailable-result branch returns a plain error while performance transport mapping recognizes typed performance errors.

overrides.replacement_claim: The shared operation runner discards invalid performance configuration and can continue instead of failing preflight.
overrides.reason: The runner discards the error returned by performanceSettings. Submitted tests have failure-signature mismatches, so executable evidence remains insufficient.

overrides.replacement_claim: The performance CLI maps every classified non-cancellation failure to the validation exit class.
overrides.reason: The CLI distinguishes context cancellation only and wraps every other performance failure with ExitValidation.

overrides.replacement_claim: The performance failure path can publish flow state after its verification writer token becomes stale because it lacks a final writer-fence check before SaveFlowState.
overrides.reason: Both theories describe the same stale-writer defect. Executable evidence revokes ownership during state publication and observes that the failure path still publishes the flow summary.

overrides.replacement_claim: ValidateRepairReverification accepts malformed nested performance target results because it validates only top-level fields.
overrides.reason: Executable evidence confirms acceptance of malformed target identity and invalid comparison outcome while valid nested data passes and malformed top-level authority is rejected.

overrides.replacement_claim: The performance-output parser accepts malformed trailing content after a valid envelope because it does not require EOF.
overrides.reason: The parser accepts any non-nil second-decode error, including malformed trailing syntax.

overrides.replacement_claim: The performance-evidence API exposes retained artifact paths and digests, and the workbench renders evidence digests.
overrides.reason: The public record exposes Path and Digest, the application returns records unchanged, and the template renders Digest.

overrides.replacement_claim: The TUI exposes mutating performance actions for a disabled project when a historical attempt exists.
overrides.reason: Static evidence shows that an existing attempt admits mutation actions despite disabled policy. The submitted test did not execute because the environment ran out of space.

overrides.replacement_claim: Fenced or HTML-commented pseudo Performance Targets headings are ignored by target parsing but treated as declarations during disabled-policy validation.
overrides.reason: Both theories describe inconsistent heading recognition. Static evidence confirms that declaration validation lacks the parser's fence and comment exclusions. The submitted test failed during dependency download before assertions ran.

overrides.replacement_claim: Performance manifest discovery accepts descriptor markers separated from a function by blank lines or comments despite requiring immediate adjacency.
overrides.reason: The discovery loop retains a pending marker across blank and comment lines. The submitted test did not execute because the environment ran out of space.

overrides.replacement_claim: Performance-specific defaults and product validation are implemented in the generic platform config package instead of the owning product module.
overrides.reason: The platform package defines performance workflow defaults and lower-only product policy contrary to the stated ownership rule.

issues.claim: Unavailable performance results bypass performance-specific error classification.
issues.title: Unavailable results lose error classification
issues.reason: The result endpoint returns a plain error and falls through generic handling.

issues.claim: Documented performance maxima are rejected by validation.
issues.title: Documented performance maxima are unusable
issues.reason: An executable configuration load rejects a documented maximum while accepting default and lower values.

issues.claim: Disabled historical performance states expose mutating TUI actions.
issues.title: TUI exposes mutations while policy is disabled
issues.reason: A historical attempt causes mutation controls to appear despite disabled policy.

issues.claim: All non-cancellation performance failures map to ExitValidation.
issues.title: Performance CLI collapses operational exit classes
issues.reason: Distinct runtime, timeout, dependency, persistence, and configuration failures become validation failures.

issues.claim: Descriptor discovery permits lines between a marker and function.
issues.title: Descriptor markers need not immediately precede functions
issues.reason: Discovery accepts layouts forbidden by the marker contract.

issues.claim: Aggregate projections omit durable lifecycle and cancellation state.
issues.title: Performance surfaces omit durable lifecycle state
issues.reason: Executable evidence shows aggregate surfaces return defaults while the dedicated query has current durable state.

issues.claim: Repair reverification accepts malformed nested target results.
issues.title: Repair validation accepts malformed target results
issues.reason: Executable evidence confirms invalid nested target identity and outcome values pass validation.

issues.claim: Public evidence responses expose artifact paths and digests.
issues.title: Performance evidence leaks artifact metadata
issues.reason: Private artifact identifiers pass through public projections and rendered output.

issues.claim: Malformed trailing JSON after a valid performance envelope is accepted.
issues.title: Performance parser accepts malformed trailing data
issues.reason: The parser does not require EOF after the envelope.

issues.claim: The evidence endpoint can return an unversioned fallback shape.
issues.title: Evidence API fallback violates its versioned schema
issues.reason: Executable evidence demonstrates two incompatible successful response shapes.

issues.claim: The shared operation runner discards performance configuration errors.
issues.title: Operation runner ignores invalid configuration
issues.reason: A configuration failure can disappear instead of stopping setup before side effects.

issues.claim: A stale performance writer can publish flow state after ownership revocation.
issues.title: Stale writer can publish flow state
issues.reason: A deterministic test observes stale flow-summary publication after ownership becomes invalid.

issues.claim: Pseudo target headings trigger disabled-policy mismatch findings.
issues.title: Pseudo headings cause false policy mismatches
issues.reason: Policy validation and target parsing disagree about fenced and commented headings.

issues.claim: The platform config package owns performance product policy.
issues.title: Performance policy is embedded in platform config
issues.reason: Product defaults and validation reside outside the owning bounded context.

evidence_requests.required_observation: Assert the runner reaches preparation or execution without returning the configuration failure.
evidence_requests.control_requirement: Include a valid-configuration control and prove whether the operation boundary was reached.

evidence_requests.required_observation: Assert the JSON response contains path and digest fields and rendered workbench output contains the digest.
evidence_requests.control_requirement: Assert raw artifact contents are absent to isolate metadata exposure.

evidence_requests.control_requirement: Include ordinary prose and a real target section as declaration controls.

evidence_requests.control_requirement: Assert the target parser ignores the same inputs and detects a real heading.

evidence_requests.control_requirement: Include a typed performance error that receives performance-specific status and code mapping.

evidence_requests.required_observation: Assert the current source defines product-specific performance defaults and validation under internal/platform.
evidence_requests.control_requirement: Restrict the assertion to named performance policy symbols so generic configuration infrastructure remains allowed.

evidence_requests.required_observation: Assert discovery accepts both separated-marker cases.
evidence_requests.control_requirement: Include an adjacent-marker control and an intervening source statement that is rejected.

evidence_requests.gap: The submitted TUI test did not execute because the environment ran out of space.
evidence_requests.requested_evidence: In the original investigator's approved private workspace, create or strengthen an executable Go _test.go reproducer evaluating navItems with Enabled=false and a historical PerformanceAttemptID.
evidence_requests.required_observation: Assert start, resume, cancel, and recover operation kinds are present.

evidence_requests.required_observation: Assert parsing succeeds and returns the canonical value despite malformed trailing content.
evidence_requests.control_requirement: Assert whitespace-only trailing content succeeds and a second valid JSON value is rejected.
